title: Gate brief: warn on files outside the slice's Files list, fence the check command
lead: The gate brief gets an "Out of scope files" section that lists changed files the slice's Files list does not cover (a warning only). The same slice fences the check command in the implementer brief so a backtick or newline renders, and cites the default-cap record beside the default in `docs/design.md`.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Seen 2026-10-20 (S50): the second S29 run edited `CHANGELOG.md`, which was not in the slice's Files list, and the report only noted it. The orchestrator caught such files by hand. `adj 119` (`engine.files-scope`, decided 2026-10-20) chose a warning, not a stop: Files lists are prose and often incomplete. The S50 note of 2026-10-23 (owner interview) says the warning goes in the gate brief only: no new `run.json` key and no version bump. `adj 119` also says the paths come from slicer, not from an ork parser.

S50's blocker is gone. Slicer s395 is done: `slicer show ID --json` returns `paths`, the backticked spans of the `files_section` (each path once, `:LINE` dropped, a directory keeps its trailing slash, not filtered by `overlap_ignore`; `../slicer/docs/agents.md:512`). Checked today: `slicer show S50 --json` returns `["internal/engine","internal/slicercli","docs/design.md"]`. The old plan to add `ItemFiles` to the slicer client is not needed: the engine already reads `slicer show ID --json --lean` as `slicercli.Detail` (`internal/engine/states.go:452-461`), so `Detail` gains a `Paths` field.

This slice is hosted on S50 and folds two rows (the folded rows are retired after it is filed; owner, 2026-10-31, later-notes rows go into sweep slices):

- S128 (from S126 A2): `BuildBrief` puts the project's `CheckCommand` in a single-backtick span (`internal/engine/brief.go:95`). A command with a backtick or a newline renders badly in the implementer brief.
- S210 (from S208): `docs/design.md:231-232` says "global cap (default 2) and the per-project cap (`wave.limits`, `engine.default-cap`)". Record `engine.default-cap` is adj 172 and decides the default; `wave.limits` is adj 20 and decides the two caps. The citation belongs beside the default.

Dropped from the old S50 text: its failing test "The run report shows the files and the policy applied" (the 2026-10-23 note says gate brief only).

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- `internal/slicercli/types.go:116-119` (`Detail` gains `Paths []string` with `json:"paths,omitempty"`).
- `internal/slicercli/slicercli_test.go` (a test beside `TestShow` at `:78`) and `testdata/cli/slicer/show-paths.json` (new fixture).
- `internal/engine/check.go` (`ScopeWarnings`; `RunCheck` starts at `:17`).
- `internal/engine/filescope.go` (new: `changedPaths` reads `git status`, `parsePorcelainZ`, `scopeSection`).
- `internal/engine/filescope_test.go` (new).
- `internal/engine/states.go:527-587` (`gate` adds the section before `runRound`).
- `internal/engine/brief.go:93-97` (fence the check command) and `internal/engine/brief_test.go` (tests beside `TestBriefNamesCheckCommand` at `:139`).
- `docs/design.md:375-378` (gate bullet) and `docs/design.md:231-232` (default-cap citation).
- `CHANGELOG.md` (an entry under `## Unreleased`).

Class: this slice touches `internal/engine`, so it is the one engine-class slice of its wave. It touches no UI file.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
In `internal/engine/filescope_test.go` unless named otherwise:

- `TestScopeWarningsNamesPathsOutsideTheList`: allowed `["internal/engine","docs/design.md"]` (no trailing slash, as slicer returns for a directory written without one) and changed `["internal/engine/check.go","CHANGELOG.md","docs/design.md","docs/design.md.bak"]` give `["CHANGELOG.md","docs/design.md.bak"]`, sorted, once each. A path is covered when it equals an entry or starts with the entry plus `/` (a trailing `/` on the entry is ignored). Fails first: `ScopeWarnings` does not exist.
- `TestScopeWarningsNoneWhenEveryPathIsListed`: no warnings.
- `TestScopeWarningsTrackingFilesAreNeverOutOfScope`: `.slicer/index.json` and `.slicer/render/ROADMAP.md` give no warning (the relay writes tracking files in the worktree, and landing commits `.slicer` itself, `internal/engine/land.go:70-78`).
- `TestScopeWarningsNeedsAList`: an empty allowed list gives no warnings, because with no Files paths the check cannot judge.
- `TestFilesScopeReadsOnlyChangedPaths`: `parsePorcelainZ` of a `git status --porcelain=v1 -z --untracked-files=all` output returns modified, added, deleted and untracked paths, both names of a rename or copy (`R  new\0old\0`), and paths with spaces, and nothing for ignored files.
- `TestGateBriefListsTheOutOfScopeFiles`: with a fake `slicer show` that returns `paths` and a fake `git status` that lists one unlisted file, the gate request's brief has `## Out of scope files` naming that file and saying it is a warning. Fails first: no such section.
- `TestGateBriefHasNoScopeSectionWhenEveryFileIsListed`.
- `TestFilesScopeNeverStopsOrPausesARun`: with an unlisted file, the run ends the gate in the same state and `Pending` as without it; with `slicer show` or `git status` failing, the gate runs with no section and no pause.
- In `internal/slicercli/slicercli_test.go`, `TestShowReadsFilesPaths`: `Show` decodes `paths` from `show-paths.json`; a document without `paths` leaves it nil.
- In `internal/engine/brief_test.go`, `TestBriefFencesCheckCommandWithBackticks`: a command with a backtick and a newline is written in a fenced block whose fence is longer than its longest backtick run (at least three), and the sentence no longer wraps the command in single backticks. Fails first: it is in a single-backtick span.
- `TestBriefKeepsAPlainCheckCommandInline`: the existing text `ork runs `go test -race ./...` and `slicer check` after the round, outside your sandbox.` is unchanged for a command with no backtick and no newline (`TestBriefNamesCheckCommand` and `TestFirstRowBriefIsUnchanged` stay green).
- `TestBriefFenceGrowsWithTheCommand`: a command containing a run of three backticks is fenced with four.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Tests first, from the lists above, and watch each fail for its stated reason.
2. `internal/slicercli/types.go`: add `Paths`. No new client method.
3. `internal/engine/check.go`: `ScopeWarnings(changed, allowed []string) []string` with the rules in the first test. Pure function, no I/O.
4. `internal/engine/filescope.go`: `parsePorcelainZ(out string) []string`; `(*Engine).scopeSection(ctx, rec) *BriefSection` reads `ShowRaw` (as `touchesUI` does, `states.go:452-461`), then `e.gitRead(ctx, rec.Worktree, "status", "--porcelain=v1", "-z", "--untracked-files=all")`. On any error, or with no paths, return nil. The body: the list, one path per line, then one sentence that this is a warning from the Files list (adj 119), that the gate decides whether each file is needed, and that it does not fail the gate by itself.
5. `internal/engine/states.go`: in `gate`, after the owner-fix sections and before `runRound`, append the section when non-nil. Do not change the state machine, `Pending`, `rec`, or any `run.json` field.
6. `internal/engine/brief.go`: when the command has no backtick and no newline, keep today's text. Otherwise write the sentence "ork runs this command, then `slicer check`, after the round, outside your sandbox:" and then the command in a fence of max(3, longest backtick run + 1) backticks.
7. `docs/design.md`: add the warn rule to the gate bullet (changed paths come from `git status` in the worktree, the item's Files paths from `slicer show --json` `paths` (slicer s395), `.slicer/` exempt, warning only, `engine.files-scope` adj 119, nothing recorded in `run.json`, a failed read adds no section). At `:231-232` write `global cap (default 2, `engine.default-cap`, adj 172) and the per-project cap (`wave.limits`)`.
8. `CHANGELOG.md`, last: add the entry at the top of the `## Unreleased` list, marked *proposed* for the gate-brief section. A parallel slice appends its entry at the bottom, so the two do not touch the same lines.

Do not touch `internal/tui`, `internal/daemon`, `cmd`, `docs/state.md`, or `run.json` keys. Do not parse the Files prose in ork. Not a UI slice.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `go test -race -count=1 ./...`; `go vet ./...`; `gofmt -l .`; `slicer check`; `adj lint`.
- `go test -race -count=1 ./internal/engine ./internal/slicercli`.
- `rg -n "engine.default-cap" docs/design.md` shows the citation beside `default 2`.
- After landing, the next relay of a slice whose diff includes a file outside its Files list shows `## Out of scope files` in the gate brief. [HUMAN CHECK] [AFTER LAND] The owner reads the first gate brief that carries the section and says whether `.slicer/` and `CHANGELOG.md` behave as wanted.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: One commit on the slice branch: "Warn on files outside the Files list in the gate brief; fence the check command".
